dog.description_text:
Meet Harbor! Every dog deserves a safe place to land, and this boy is hoping to find his very own harbor of love. Rescued from a heartbreaking hoarding situation in Georgia, Harbor is ready for a fresh start and a chance to discover all the wonderful things life has to offer. Now he just needs someone willing to open their heart and home to him. Could you be the safe haven Harbor has been waiting for?

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Harbor and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
